speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_06
speech_events.text: Till now, it hasn't worked in Uttar Pradesh.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_06
speech_events.text: It also, I would think, worked in Bengal as well in pockets.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: His game worked in Bihar, but I don't think he's... But it hasn't ever worked in Uttar Pradesh.

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_00
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: And OIC is just a spoiler, as he always think he is.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_02
speech_events.text: I would like to ask a simple question to the Samajwadi party spokespersons, especially to the Muslim MLAs and the MPs.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_02
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: Here also what we are seeing Akhilesh now going to Ayodhya.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_02
speech_events.text: We are fighting for the protection of the community.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_02
speech_events.text: And so we have founded an alliance.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_02
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: What have they got to say now?

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_02
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: See, that is why we say you took the name of, you took the votes of, this is the name of secularism.

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_02
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: What have they got to say now?

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_06
speech_events.text: So it doesn't matter, you will even join hands with an anti-Muslim party and a BJP team to defeat the BJP.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_02
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: That is why we told them.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_06
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: Okay, you made your point sir.

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_02
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: That is why we told them.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_01
speech_events.text: So when you when you try to be everything to everyone, you end up just being a congressman.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: You're trying to be pleasing to too many constituents together.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: And in this, in this sort of a setting,

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_01
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: You're trying to be pleasing to too many constituents together.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_01
speech_events.text: So my point is that when the MIM and when Chandrasekhar Azad, they make more shrill arguments, they suddenly stand to draw a lot of attention because a Samajwadi party is trying to be too risk averse in its position.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: So when you when you try to be everything to everyone, you end up just being a congressman.

notes: This artifact is a separate analysis output; it does not modify final.json or any existing pipeline stage.
Transcript text and source segment timestamps are preserved exactly; events may extend beyond the 3-second window and are flagged.
All classification and host-behavior fields are intentionally unclassified pending manual verification and later LLM analysis.
first_speaker_in_window accounts for speech already active at the window boundary; first_new_speaker_after_overlap separately records a segment beginning after the overlap.
Tied or ambiguous speaker starts are represented as null rather than forcing a conclusion.
Speaker labels are diarization labels, not verified real-world identities.
